steps.prompt: Our LD goes up the far wall. Why hold your hash marks a moment longer?

options.text: Leave now and their LW follows me into the middle
options.fb: Right. He's sitting on you. Go now and you drag him into the middle lane, so it's dead before the puck gets there.

options.text: I'm the outlet if our LD reverses it to my side
options.fb: True, but it's not the main reason. The main reason is their LW: leave early and he comes with you, and the middle is covered.
You're nowhere near the line. Holding is about their LW, not the blue line: if you go, he goes.

steps.prompt: The puck is on the far wall, moving up. Leave now for the middle lane at the blue line, or hold your wall?

options.text: Leave now, on the pass up the far wall
options.fb: Right. Leave on the pass up the far wall. Earlier and their LW comes with you and the middle is dead; later and our LW has nobody in the middle when the pressure arrives. Now you're in the lane with speed when he needs you.

options.text: Hold until our LW has it under control, then go
options.fb: Half a second late. The pressure reaches our LW at 3.0 s, and if you're still on your wall he has nobody in the middle and eats it or throws it blind.

options.text: I left at the start and I'm waiting in the middle
options.fb: Their LW followed you. The middle lane is covered, our LW has nobody to pass to, and the pass he forces gets picked off in front of you.

options.text: Hold the wall, the outlet is up the far side
options.fb: Then there's no middle lane at all. Our LW is alone against the pressure and the breakout dies on the far wall.

steps.prompt: The puck is moving up the far wall. Tap where you should be.

fb.right: Just off your hash marks, leaving now for the middle lane, their LW still on the wall.
fb.close: On the right path but a stride off, early or late. A stride early and he comes with you; a stride late and our LW is waiting.
fb.wrong: Either still parked on the wall or already in the middle. One leaves our LW alone, the other takes their LW into the lane with you.
